theme_and_context.core_vibe: Professional, Modern, Technical, Elegant, Clean, Empresarial, Minimalista. Communicates precision, engineering, quality, trust, and traceability.
theme_and_context.theme_preference: Light theme default, optional Dark mode via standard toggle.

headings.usage: Used for all dashboard titles, card headers, and module headers. Conveys technical precision and engineering rigor.

body.usage: Highly legible geometric sans for dense data tables, forms, and general UI text.

overlines_and_badges.usage: Status badges, small column headers, step indicators.

rules: Never use default 'Inter' for headings. Keep it distinct with IBM Plex Sans.

components.cards_and_surfaces: Flat solid backgrounds with crisp 1px borders (border-slate-200 in light, border-slate-800 in dark). Minimal shadows (shadow-sm only) to preserve the technical/engineering feel. Max border-radius: rounded-lg (8px).
components.buttons: Standard Shadcn UI buttons. Primary buttons use Corporate Navy (bg-slate-900 text-white) or Secondary Light Blue. Add slight transform on hover (-translate-y-[1px]).
components.sidebar: Collapsible, categorized into logical groups (Operación, Laboratorio, Administración, Sistema). Active states should have a subtle background and a left border highlight in Light Blue.
components.tables: Dense layout suitable for enterprise data. Hover states on rows. Sticky headers for long lists. Include pagination and global search.
components.tabs_and_wizards: Use clear steps. 5-step wizard for Work Orders should have horizontal line connectors and clear active/completed states.
components.modals_drawers: Use slide-out drawers (Sheet) for audit logs to preserve context. Use Modals (Dialog) for explicit actions (Send to Review, Rejection reasons).

grids_and_layouts.dashboard_grid: High-density Grid (Mode B). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4. Gap-4 to Gap-6.
grids_and_layouts.split_review_screen: Flagship screen: CSS Grid with 2 main columns (lg:grid-cols-12). Left side (col-span-4 or 5) for structured data and approval controls. Right side (col-span-8 or 7) for PDF viewer placeholder. Use h-[calc(100vh-theme(spacing.16))] to maximize screen real estate.
grids_and_layouts.spacing_rules: Use p-4 or p-6 for card internals. Ensure breathing room, but maintain enterprise density.

motion.hover_states: All interactive elements must change on hover. Subdued transitions (transition-colors duration-200).
motion.page_transitions: Use Framer Motion for soft fade-ins on route changes or tab switching.
motion.lists: Staggered entrance animations for instrument cards or certificate lists.

media_and_icons.icons_library: lucide-react (Matches the technical and clean aesthetic perfectly).

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: CRITICAL: The codebase uses .js/.jsx files. DO NOT output or expect .tsx files for Shadcn/React components.
You MUST use HTML and standard Tailwind classes for custom layouts instead of over-relying on restrictive pre-built container components, unless using Shadcn UI primitives.
DO NOT apply `transition: all` globally. Apply transitions to specific properties like `transition-colors` or `transition-transform`.
All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, dropdowns) MUST have `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid="login-submit-button"`).
The split review screen (Data on left, PDF on right) is the flagship feature and MUST be highly polished, visually separated, and use `h-full` to maximize viewport usage.
Use mock data explicitly mentioned in the prompt (RF/calibration instruments: Spectrum Analyzer, Signal Generator; brands: Keysight, Rohde & Schwarz, Fluke, Tektronix).
Format variables strictly: Certificates MUST follow QLM-CC-XXXX-2026, Orders MUST follow QLM-OT-2026-XXXX.

Implement a robust mock role switcher in the UI (simulated login or header dropdown) to toggle between: Técnico de Laboratorio, Jefe de Laboratorio, Finanzas, Administrador. The UI should physically change based on the selected role.
Never use purely transparent backgrounds on overlays/dropdowns; always use solid colors or glassmorphism (backdrop-blur + bg-white/90).
Use recharts for the required charts: services per month, orders by state, workload per technician, monthly billing, aging.
